Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG): The Successful Bidder shall furnish a Performance Bank G uarantee (PBG) at the rate of ₹2,655/- (Rupees Two Thousand Six Hundred Fif ty-Five only) per kWp. The final project capacity (in kWp) shall be determined by the Successful Bidder after co mpletion of the detailed site survey within the timeline stipulated in the RfS.
